Please refresh **http://maker:4001**:

**Removing a bookmark.** On any saved link, click the new **Delete** button (next to Rename). It doesn't vanish instantly — instead it asks *"Delete this bookmark?"* with **Delete** / **Keep**. Click **Keep** to cancel; click **Delete** to actually remove it, and it disappears from the list.

- I put a **quick confirm step** before deleting so a stray click can't lose a bookmark. Is a confirm the right call, or would you rather it just delete immediately?

**Very long titles.** Try saving a link with a long address, e.g.
`https://example.com/this-is-a-very-long-article-title-that-keeps-going-and-going-to-see-how-it-wraps` — then **Rename** it to something long too. Notice the long title and address **wrap neatly within the card** rather than overflowing.

- I chose to let long names **wrap onto multiple lines** (rather than cut them off with "…"). Does seeing the full text suit you?

Two questions I can't demonstrate on this throwaway prototype, so let me just confirm the intent:

- **Coming back later:** you'd expect the bookmarks you save to **still be there next time you open the app** (not disappear when you close the browser) — correct?
- When you **delete** a bookmark that was in your read-later list, it should simply be gone from everywhere, including the "To read" count — right?
